# aegov-dls-angular

> Unofficial, community-driven Angular 19+ port of the UAE Government Design Language System (AEGOV DLS). Built with Standalone Components, Angular Signals, modern control flow (@if, @for), Tailwind CSS v4, and Phosphor Icons.

## Setup & Global Requirements

1. **Installation**:
```bash
npm install aegov-dls-angular @angular/cdk
```

2. **Global Stylesheet**:
Must include the compiled Tailwind v4 CSS in the global stylesheet (`styles.css` or `angular.json`):
```css
@import "aegov-dls-angular/styles/tailwind.css";
```

3. **Standalone Component Import**:
Always import components and types directly from `'aegov-dls-angular'`. Standalone architecture is used throughout; never import an `NgModule`.
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { ButtonComponent, InputComponent, AlertComponent, IconComponent, NavigationComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-example',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ButtonComponent, InputComponent, AlertComponent, IconComponent, NavigationComponent],
  template: `...`
})
export class ExampleComponent {}
```

---

## Component Index & Reference

### 1. Button (`ae-button`, `button[ae-button]`, `a[ae-button]`)
- **Import**: `import { ButtonComponent, ButtonColor, ButtonVariant, ButtonSize } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Selectors**: `<ae-button>`, `<button ae-button>`, `<a ae-button>`
- **Inputs**:
  - `color`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `variant`: `'solid' | 'soft' | 'link' | 'outline' | 'outline-solid'` (default: `'solid'`)
  - `size`: `'xs' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `block`: `boolean` (full width, default: `false`)
  - `isIcon`: `boolean` (square icon button, default: `false`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `type`: `'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'` (default: `'button'`)
  - `href`: `string` (renders `<a>` tag inside when set)
  - `target`: `string`
  - `rel`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-button color="primary" variant="solid" size="base">
  Submit Application
</ae-button>

<a ae-button href="/portal" color="secondary" variant="outline">
  Go to Portal
</a>
```

### 2. Icon (`ae-icon`) & Icon Registry
- **Import**: `import { IconComponent, provideAeIcons, AeIconRegistry } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `name`: `string` (Phosphor icon name)
  - `svg`: `string` (direct raw SVG path string)
  - `weight`: `'regular' | 'bold' | 'fill' | 'light' | 'thin' | 'duotone'` (default: `'regular'`)
  - `size`: `number | string` (default: `16`)
  - `flipRtl`: `boolean` (automatically flips 180 degrees in RTL mode)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Bundled Default Icons** (zero configuration required):
  `arrow-counter-clockwise`, `arrow-left`, `arrow-right`, `bell-simple`, `caret-double-left`, `caret-double-right`, `caret-down`, `caret-left`, `caret-right`, `caret-up`, `check-circle`, `check`, `eye-slash`, `eye`, `file-text`, `globe`, `house`, `image`, `info`, `list`, `magnifying-glass`, `moon`, `person-arms-spread`, `quotes`, `sun`, `upload-simple`, `user`, `warning-circle`, `warning`, `x-circle`, `x` (plus bold `caret-down` and fill variants for alerts/toasts).
- **Register Custom Icons** (in `app.config.ts` or component providers):
```typescript
import { provideAeIcons } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

export const appConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideAeIcons({
      heart: '<path d="..."/>',
      gear: '<path d="..."/>',
    }),
  ],
};
```
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-icon name="check" [size]="20" class="text-primary-600"></ae-icon>
<ae-icon name="caret-down" weight="bold" [size]="16"></ae-icon>
<ae-icon name="caret-right" [flipRtl]="true" [size]="20"></ae-icon>
```

### 3. Navigation (`ae-navigation`, `ae-nav-item`, `ae-main-menu`, `ae-secondary-menu`)
- **Import**: `import { NavigationComponent, NavItemComponent, MainMenuComponent, SecondaryMenuComponent, NavItemData, NavDropdownGroup, NavBreakpoint } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs on `ae-navigation`**:
  - `items`: `NavItemData[]` (data-driven navigation items)
  - `breakpoint`: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl'` (default: `'xl'`)
  - `drawerTitle`: `string` (default: `'UAE Gov Menu'`)
  - `drawerToggleLabel`: `string` (default: `'Toggle main menu'`)
  - `drawerCloseLabel`: `string` (default: `'Close menu'`)
  - `containerClass`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Slots on `ae-navigation`**:
  - `[top-bar]` / `[slot=top-bar]`: Desktop branding header (logos, search inputs)
  - `[logo]` / `[slot=logo]`: Mobile header branding logo
  - `[mobile-actions]` / `[slot=mobile-actions]`: Persistent mobile action buttons
  - `[drawer-header]`: Custom mobile drawer header
  - `[drawer-body]`: Custom mobile drawer content projection
  - `[drawer-footer]`: Mobile drawer footer links
  - `ae-main-menu` / `[main-menu]`: Custom desktop main menu navigation
  - `ae-secondary-menu` / `[secondary-menu]`: Custom desktop utility icons (language, login, accessibility)
- **Features**:
  - Supports both router SPA navigation via `routerLink` and external navigation via `href`.
  - Mega-menu dropdowns with hover & click support.
  - Active and hover indicator bottom border on all items.
  - Mobile full-screen drawer with accordion menus.
- **Usage**:
```typescript
navItems: NavItemData[] = [
  { label: 'Home', routerLink: '/', icon: 'house' },
  {
    label: 'Services',
    dropdown: [
      {
        title: 'Individual Services',
        items: [
          { label: 'Digital Identity (UAE PASS)', routerLink: '/services/uae-pass' },
          { label: 'Residency Permits', routerLink: '/services/residency' }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  { label: 'About Us', href: '/about' }
];
```
```html
<ae-navigation [items]="navItems" breakpoint="xl">
  <div slot="top-bar" class="container mx-auto px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
    <img src="/logo.svg" alt="UAE Gov" class="h-10">
  </div>
  <div slot="logo">
    <img src="/logo.svg" alt="UAE Gov" class="h-8">
  </div>
  <ae-secondary-menu secondary-menu>
    <button class="p-2 text-aeblack-700 hover:text-primary-700" title="User Login">
      <ae-icon name="user" [size]="20"></ae-icon>
    </button>
  </ae-secondary-menu>
</ae-navigation>
```

### 4. Input (`ae-input`)
- **Import**: `import { InputComponent, InputSize, InputVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `type`: `string` (`'text' | 'password' | 'email' | 'number' | 'search' | 'tel' | 'url'`, default: `'text'`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `error`: `string` (displays error message and activates error styling)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `name`: `string`
  - `hasPrefix`: `boolean`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Slots**: `[prefix]`, `[suffix]`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-input
  label="Emirates ID"
  placeholder="784-XXXX-XXXXXXX-X"
  [(ngModel)]="emiratesId"
  [required]="true"
  helperText="Enter 15 digit Emirates ID">
</ae-input>
```

### 5. Textarea (`ae-textarea`)
- **Import**: `import { TextareaComponent, TextareaSize, TextareaVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string`
  - `rows`: `number` (default: `4`)
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `error`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `name`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-textarea
  label="Feedback / Comments"
  placeholder="Write your comments here..."
  [(ngModel)]="comments"
  [rows]="5">
</ae-textarea>
```

### 6. Select (`ae-select`)
- **Import**: `import { SelectComponent, SelectOption, SelectSize, SelectVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `options`: `SelectOption[]` (`{ value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `placeholder`: `string` (default: `'Select an option'`)
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `error`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-select
  label="Select Emirate"
  [options]="[
    { value: 'auh', label: 'Abu Dhabi' },
    { value: 'dxb', label: 'Dubai' },
    { value: 'shj', label: 'Sharjah' }
  ]"
  [(ngModel)]="selectedEmirate">
</ae-select>
```

### 7. Checkbox (`ae-checkbox`)
- **Import**: `import { CheckboxComponent, CheckboxSize, CheckboxVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `checked`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `description`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `name`: `string`
  - `value`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `checkedChange`: `EventEmitter<boolean>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-checkbox
  [(ngModel)]="agreed"
  label="I agree to the Terms and Conditions"
  description="Please read our privacy policy and terms before continuing.">
</ae-checkbox>
```

### 8. Radio Group & Radio Item (`ae-radio-group`, `ae-radio-item`)
- **Import**: `import { RadioGroupComponent, RadioItemComponent, RadioSize, RadioVariant, RadioOrientation } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: `ae-radio-group` implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs on `ae-radio-group`**:
  - `name`: `string`
  - `value`: `string`
  - `defaultValue`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `orientation`: `'horizontal' | 'vertical'` (default: `'vertical'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs on `ae-radio-group`**:
  - `change`: `EventEmitter<string>`
- **Inputs on `ae-radio-item`**:
  - `value`: `string` (required)
  - `label`: `string` (or use projected content)
  - `description`: `string`
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-radio-group [(ngModel)]="plan" orientation="vertical">
  <ae-radio-item value="standard" label="Standard Plan" description="Basic digital government services."></ae-radio-item>
  <ae-radio-item value="premium" label="Premium Plan" description="Priority processing and dedicated support."></ae-radio-item>
</ae-radio-group>
```

### 9. Toggle Switch (`ae-toggle`)
- **Import**: `import { ToggleComponent, ToggleVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `checked`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'success' | 'mode' | 'secondary'` (default: `'default'`, `'mode'` shows sun/moon icons)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `checkedChange`: `EventEmitter<boolean>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-toggle [(ngModel)]="notifications" label="Enable SMS Notifications"></ae-toggle>
<ae-toggle [(ngModel)]="isDarkMode" variant="mode" label="Dark Mode"></ae-toggle>
```

### 10. Alert (`ae-alert`)
- **Import**: `import { AlertComponent, AlertVariant, AlertSize, AlertTone, AlertAction } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `variant`: `'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'error'` (default: `'info'`)
  - `tone`: `'soft' | 'solid'` (default: `'soft'`)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `title`: `string`
  - `showIcon`: `boolean` (default: `true`)
  - `dismissible`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `action`: `{ text: string, href: string }`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `dismiss`: `EventEmitter<void>`
  - `onDismiss`: `EventEmitter<void>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-alert variant="success" tone="soft" title="Application Approved" [dismissible]="true">
  Your digital permit has been issued successfully.
</ae-alert>
```

### 11. Banner (`ae-banner`)
- **Import**: `import { BannerComponent, BannerVariant, BannerPosition, BannerAction } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `title`: `string`
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'camel' | 'red' | 'dark' | 'primaryNotice' | 'secondaryNotice'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `position`: `'top' | 'bottom' | 'static'` (default: `'static'`)
  - `dismissible`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `action`: `{ text: string, href?: string, onClick?: () => void }`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `dismiss`: `EventEmitter<void>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-banner variant="camel" title="System Maintenance" [dismissible]="true" [action]="{ text: 'Learn More', href: '/maintenance' }">
  Scheduled maintenance on Saturday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM GST.
</ae-banner>
```

### 12. Modal (`ae-modal`)
- **Import**: `import { ModalComponent, ModalSize, ModalVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `isOpen`: `boolean` (controlled visibility, default: `false`)
  - `title`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'` (default: `'md'`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'danger'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `closeOnBackdrop`: `boolean` (default: `true`)
  - `class`: `string`
  - `dialogClass`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `close`: `EventEmitter<void>`
  - `openChange`: `EventEmitter<boolean>`
- **Slots**: `[trigger]`, default `<ng-content>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-modal [isOpen]="isModalOpen" (close)="isModalOpen = false" title="Confirm Application">
  <p class="text-gray-600 mb-6">Are you sure you want to submit your final application?</p>
  <div class="flex justify-end gap-3">
    <ae-button variant="outline" color="secondary" (click)="isModalOpen = false">Cancel</ae-button>
    <ae-button color="primary" (click)="confirmAction()">Confirm</ae-button>
  </div>
</ae-modal>
```

### 13. Toast (`ae-toast`, `ToastService`)
- **Import**: `import { ToastComponent, ToastService, ToastMessage } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Service API**:
  - `toastService.success(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.error(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.info(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.warning(message, title?)`
  - `toastService.show({ message, title?, variant?, duration? })`
  - `toastService.dismiss(id)`
- **App Setup**: Place `<ae-toast></ae-toast>` once in `app.component.html`.
- **Usage**:
```typescript
import { Component, inject } from '@angular/core';
import { ToastComponent, ToastService, ButtonComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ToastComponent, ButtonComponent],
  template: `
    <ae-button (click)="notify()">Notify</ae-button>
    <ae-toast></ae-toast>
  `
})
export class AppComponent {
  private toast = inject(ToastService);

  notify() {
    this.toast.success('Document uploaded successfully!', 'Upload Complete');
  }
}
```

### 14. Accordion (`ae-accordion`, `ae-accordion-item`)
- **Import**: `import { AccordionComponent, AccordionItemComponent, AccordionItemData } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs on `ae-accordion`**:
  - `items`: `AccordionItemData[]` (data-driven mode, optional)
  - `multiple`: `boolean` (allow multiple open panels, default: `false`)
  - `collapsible`: `boolean` (allow closing all panels, default: `true`)
  - `defaultValue`: `string | string[]` (initial open item value)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs on `ae-accordion`**:
  - `valueChange`: `EventEmitter<string | string[]>`
  - `onValueChange`: `EventEmitter<string | string[]>`
- **Inputs on `ae-accordion-item`**:
  - `value`: `string` (required unique identifier)
  - `title`: `string` (required title text)
  - `children`: `string` (optional body text)
  - `icon`: `IconName` (default: `'caret-down'`)
  - `iconRotateDeg`: `number` (default: `180`)
- **Usage (Component Mode)**:
```html
<ae-accordion [multiple]="false">
  <ae-accordion-item value="prereq" title="What are the prerequisites?">
    Valid Emirates ID and registered UAE PASS account.
  </ae-accordion-item>
  <ae-accordion-item value="duration" title="How long does processing take?">
    Instant issuance for digital government services.
  </ae-accordion-item>
</ae-accordion>
```

### 15. Tabs (`ae-tabs`)
- **Import**: `import { TabsComponent, TabItem, TabsVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `items`: `TabItem[]` (`{ value: string, label: string, content?: string, icon?: IconName }`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'pills' | 'compact'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `defaultValue`: `string` (initial active tab value)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `tabChange`: `EventEmitter<string>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-tabs
  variant="pills"
  [items]="[
    { value: 'personal', label: 'Personal Info', content: 'Personal details form' },
    { value: 'documents', label: 'Documents', content: 'Uploaded documents list' }
  ]"
  (tabChange)="onTabSelected($event)">
</ae-tabs>
```

### 16. Dropdown (`ae-dropdown`)
- **Import**: `import { DropdownComponent, DropdownGroupData, DropdownItemData, DropdownAlign, DropdownSide } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `groups`: `DropdownGroupData[]` (`{ label?: string, items: { label: string, value: string, icon?: IconName, disabled?: boolean }[] }`)
  - `header`: `string`
  - `align`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end'` (default: `'start'`)
  - `side`: `'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'` (default: `'bottom'`)
  - `trigger`: `'click' | 'hover'` (default: `'click'`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `select`: `EventEmitter<string>`
- **Slots**: `[trigger]`, default `<ng-content>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-dropdown
  [groups]="[
    { items: [
      { label: 'Profile', value: 'profile', icon: 'user' },
      { label: 'Settings', value: 'settings' }
    ]}
  ]"
  (select)="onSelect($event)">
  <ae-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">Options</ae-button>
</ae-dropdown>
```

### 17. Tooltip Directive (`[aeTooltip]`) & Component (`ae-tooltip`)
- **Import**: `import { TooltipDirective, TooltipComponent, TooltipSide, TooltipAlign } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Directive Usage**:
  - `aeTooltip`: `string` (required tooltip text)
  - `tooltipSide`: `'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'` (default: `'top'`)
```html
<ae-button aeTooltip="Click to download your permit" tooltipSide="top">
  Download
</ae-button>
```
- **Component Usage**:
  - `content`: `string`
  - `side`: `'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'` (default: `'top'`)
  - `align`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end'` (default: `'center'`)
  - `isOpen`: `boolean`
```html
<ae-tooltip content="Verified UAE Government Organization" side="top">
  <span class="cursor-pointer font-bold">Ministry of Economy</span>
</ae-tooltip>
```

### 18. Popover (`ae-popover`)
- **Import**: `import { PopoverComponent, PopoverTrigger, PopoverSide, PopoverAlign } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `side`: `'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'` (default: `'bottom'`)
  - `align`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end'` (default: `'center'`)
  - `trigger`: `'click' | 'hover'` (default: `'click'`)
  - `sideOffset`: `number` (default: `5`)
  - `isOpen`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `openChange`: `EventEmitter<boolean>`
- **Slots**: `[trigger]`, default `<ng-content>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-popover side="bottom" align="center" trigger="click">
  <ae-button slot="trigger" variant="outline">View Details</ae-button>
  <div class="p-3 text-sm">
    <h4 class="font-bold mb-1">Service Fee</h4>
    <p class="text-gray-600">AED 150 inclusive of VAT.</p>
  </div>
</ae-popover>
```

### 19. Card (`ae-card`, `ae-card-link`, `ae-card-stack`)
- **Import**: `import { CardComponent, CardLinkComponent, CardStackComponent, CardVariant, CardSize, CardStackDirection } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs on `ae-card`**:
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'news' | 'service' | 'creative'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `bordered`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `glow`: `boolean` (default: `false`, enables hover glow shadow)
  - `noRadius`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Inputs on `ae-card-link`**:
  - `href`: `string` (default: `'#'`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Inputs on `ae-card-stack`**:
  - `direction`: `'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'matrix'` (default: `'horizontal'`)
  - `columns`: `number` (default: `3`)
  - `collapsed`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `gap`: `number` (default: `4`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-card variant="default" size="base" bordered glow>
  <h5 class="text-h5 font-extrabold">Service Overview</h5>
  <p class="text-gray-600">Detailed information about the selected government service.</p>
  <ae-card-link href="/services">View details</ae-card-link>
</ae-card>
```

### 20. Breadcrumbs (`ae-breadcrumbs`)
- **Import**: `import { BreadcrumbsComponent, BreadcrumbItemData, BreadcrumbSeparator } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `items`: `BreadcrumbItemData[]` (`{ label: string, href?: string, icon?: string }`)
  - `separator`: `'slash' | 'caret'` (default: `'slash'`)
  - `showHomeIcon`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Note**: The last item in `items` is automatically rendered as the current active breadcrumb page.
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-breadcrumbs
  separator="slash"
  [showHomeIcon]="true"
  [items]="[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Services', href: '/services' },
    { label: 'Residency' }
  ]">
</ae-breadcrumbs>
```

### 21. Pagination (`ae-pagination`)
- **Import**: `import { PaginationComponent } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `totalPages`: `number` (total number of pages, default: `1`)
  - `currentPage`: `number` (active page number, 1-indexed, default: `1`)
  - `showFirstLast`: `boolean` (display First and Last navigation buttons, default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `pageChange`: `EventEmitter<number>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-pagination
  [totalPages]="10"
  [currentPage]="currentPage"
  [showFirstLast]="true"
  (pageChange)="onPageChange($event)">
</ae-pagination>
```

### 22. Steps (`ae-steps`)
- **Import**: `import { StepsComponent, StepItem, StepsSize, StepsOrientation } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `steps`: `StepItem[]` (`{ label: string, href?: string }`)
  - `currentStep`: `number` (0-indexed current active step, default: `0`)
  - `orientation`: `'horizontal' | 'vertical'` (default: `'horizontal'`)
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `showLabels`: `boolean` (displays step label text next to or under numbers, default: `false`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-steps
  [currentStep]="1"
  orientation="horizontal"
  [showLabels]="true"
  [steps]="[
    { label: 'Identity Verification' },
    { label: 'Application Details' },
    { label: 'Payment & Confirmation' }
  ]">
</ae-steps>
```

### 23. File Upload (`ae-file-upload`)
- **Import**: `import { FileUploadComponent, FileUploadVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'simple' | 'card' | 'withPreview' | 'dragDrop'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `label`: `string` (default: `'Upload file'`)
  - `maxFiles`: `number` (default: `1`)
  - `accept`: `string` (standard accept attribute e.g. `".pdf,.png"`)
  - `acceptedFileTypes`: `Record<string, string[]> | string`
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Outputs**:
  - `filesSelected`: `EventEmitter<File[]>`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-file-upload
  variant="dragDrop"
  label="Upload Documents"
  accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg"
  [maxFiles]="3"
  (filesSelected)="onFilesUploaded($event)">
</ae-file-upload>
```

### 24. Range Slider (`ae-range-slider`)
- **Import**: `import { RangeSliderComponent, RangeSliderSize, RangeSliderVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Features**: Implements `ControlValueAccessor` (`[(ngModel)]` and `[formControl]`).
- **Inputs**:
  - `min`: `number` (default: `0`)
  - `max`: `number` (default: `100`)
  - `step`: `number` (default: `1`)
  - `label`: `string`
  - `helperText`: `string`
  - `error`: `string`
  - `size`: `'sm' | 'base' | 'lg'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'primary' | 'secondary'` (default: `'primary'`)
  - `disabled`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `required`: `boolean` (default: `false`)
  - `id`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-range-slider
  label="Investment Amount (AED)"
  [min]="1000"
  [max]="50000"
  [step]="500"
  [(ngModel)]="amount">
</ae-range-slider>
```

### 25. Avatar (`ae-avatar`)
- **Import**: `import { AvatarComponent, AvatarSize, AvatarVariant, AvatarStatus } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `src`: `string` (image URL)
  - `alt`: `string` (default: `'Avatar'`)
  - `fallback`: `string` (text/initials shown if `src` fails or is omitted)
  - `size`: `'xs' | 'sm' | 'base' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl'` (default: `'base'`)
  - `variant`: `'square' | 'rounded-sm' | 'rounded' | 'circle'` (default: `'square'`)
  - `status`: `'online' | 'offline' | 'none'` (default: `'none'`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-avatar src="/avatar.jpg" alt="User" size="lg" variant="circle" status="online"></ae-avatar>
<ae-avatar fallback="JD" size="base" variant="rounded"></ae-avatar>
```

### 26. Blockquote (`ae-blockquote`)
- **Import**: `import { BlockquoteComponent, BlockquoteTone } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `author`: `string`
  - `authorTitle`: `string`
  - `cite`: `string`
  - `tone`: `'soft' | 'solid'` (default: `'soft'`)
  - `class`: `string`
- **Features**: Soft tone automatically includes the Phosphor quotation icon mirrored horizontally (`“`) in LTR and adapted for RTL.
- **Usage**:
```html
<ae-blockquote author="Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum" tone="soft">
  "The future belongs to those who can imagine it, design it, and execute it."
</ae-blockquote>
```

### 27. Hyperlink (`ae-hyperlink`, `a[ae-hyperlink]`)
- **Import**: `import { HyperlinkComponent, HyperlinkVariant } from 'aegov-dls-angular';`
- **Inputs**:
  - `showIcon`: `boolean` (controls whether trailing icon is shown, default: `false`)
  - `icon`: `string` (Phosphor icon name displayed when `showIcon` is `true`, default: `'caret-right'`)
  - `routerLink`: `string | any[]` (Angular SPA route navigation)
  - `queryParams`: `Params`
  - `fragment`: `string`
  - `queryParamsHandling`: `QueryParamsHandling` (`'merge' | 'preserve' | ''`)
  - `routerLinkActive`: `string | string[]`
  - `routerLinkActiveOptions`: `{ exact: boolean } | IsActiveMatchOptions`
  - `href`: `string` (external or standard anchor link, default: `'#'`)
  - `variant`: `'default' | 'cta' | 'soft' | 'secondary' | 'secondary-soft'` (default: `'default'`)
  - `external`: `boolean` (opens in new tab with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, default: `false`)
  - `label`: `string` (or use inner template content via `<ng-content>`)
  - `target`: `string`
  - `rel`: `string`
  - `class`: `string`
- **Usage**:
```html
<!-- Custom icon (e.g. arrow-right) with router navigation -->
<ae-hyperlink routerLink="/myapplications" variant="secondary" [showIcon]="true" icon="arrow-right">
  View All
</ae-hyperlink>

<!-- Default caret-right icon with router navigation -->
<ae-hyperlink routerLink="/services" variant="cta" [showIcon]="true">
  Browse Services
</ae-hyperlink>

<!-- External link opening in a new tab -->
<ae-hyperlink href="https://u.ae" [external]="true">
  Visit Official Portal
</ae-hyperlink>

<!-- Standard inline text link without icon -->
<ae-hyperlink routerLink="/privacy">
  Privacy Policy
</ae-hyperlink>
```

---

## Best Practices for AI Code Generation

1. **Always use standalone imports**: Never attempt to import an `NgModule` (e.g. do NOT do `AegovModule`). Import the exact component class needed (e.g. `[ButtonComponent, InputComponent, NavigationComponent]`).
2. **Always include the Tailwind CSS import**: Global styles must contain `@import "aegov-dls-angular/styles/tailwind.css";`.
3. **Use Phosphor Icon names**: Use valid icon names for `leftIcon`, `rightIcon`, or `<ae-icon name="...">` (e.g. `'check'`, `'x'`, `'arrow-right'`, `'magnifying-glass'`, `'eye'`, `'eye-slash'`, `'user'`, `'house'`, `'globe'`, `'person-arms-spread'`).
4. **Use exact button color literal types**: `color="primary"` or `color="secondary"`. Variant types: `variant="solid" | "soft" | "link" | "outline" | "outline-solid"`.
5. **Form components implement ControlValueAccessor**: Use `[(ngModel)]` or `[formControl]` directly with `<ae-input>`, `<ae-textarea>`, `<ae-select>`, `<ae-checkbox>`, `<ae-radio-group>`, `<ae-toggle>`, `<ae-range-slider>`.
6. **Navigation and Hyperlink support SPA routing**: Use `routerLink` on `<ae-hyperlink>` and `NavItemData` for Angular SPA routes, or `href` for external links.
